notes: Curated for the Budget-Aware Research Agent wedge, not a wholesale import of the Public APIs repo.
These providers are intended as structured free-source candidates before paid escalation.
Selection bias: favored APIs that improve repeatability, structured retrieval, or known-domain lookups.

providers.name: Open Library
providers.whyUseful: Structured factual lookup for books and authors. Better than web search for known titles.
providers.whenToUse: Known books, citations, authors, ISBNs, editions.
providers.whenNotToUse: Current ecosystem scans or broad tool landscapes.
exampleQueryShapes: Find the publication history of a book
Look up editions for this ISBN

providers.name: Crossref Metadata Search
providers.whyUseful: Strong structured metadata for papers, DOIs, and citations.
providers.whenToUse: Academic references, publication lookups, DOI resolution.
providers.whenNotToUse: Fresh market landscapes or commercial vendor discovery.
exampleQueryShapes: Find recent papers on x402
Resolve this DOI and get metadata

providers.name: Domainsdb.info
providers.whyUseful: Can help find or verify domains tied to companies or naming patterns.
providers.whenToUse: Known company names, domain discovery, domain variants.
providers.whenNotToUse: Deep company enrichment or current vendor landscape scans.
exampleQueryShapes: Find likely domains for this company
Check if this naming pattern exists as domains

providers.name: UK Bank Holidays
providers.whyUseful: Very stable structured holiday data for a narrow slice of date questions.
exampleQueryShapes: Is this date a UK bank holiday?

providers.name: Nager.Date
providers.whyUseful: Useful structured holiday lookup across many countries.
providers.whenNotToUse: Current market research or vendor discovery.
exampleQueryShapes: What holidays are coming up in Germany?

providers.name: CoinGecko
providers.whyUseful: Strong free structured crypto market and project data. Good for known-token or known-project lookups.
providers.whenToUse: Crypto project facts, token metadata, market metrics.
providers.whenNotToUse: Cross-vendor agent tooling landscapes unless crypto-specific.
exampleQueryShapes: Get metadata for this token
Compare these crypto projects

providers.name: DefiLlama
providers.whyUseful: Strong structured protocol and project lookup for crypto ecosystems. Better fit than generic web search for known protocol, chain, and DeFi entity questions.
providers.whenToUse: Known protocols, chain ecosystems, tokenized project comparisons, Base-adjacent entity lookup.
providers.whenNotToUse: Broad non-crypto vendor landscapes or purely conceptual questions.
exampleQueryShapes: Compare Base protocols by TVL
Look up this protocol or chain project

providers.name: CoinCap
providers.whyUseful: Simple structured asset pricing and market lookups.
exampleQueryShapes: What is the current market cap of X?

providers.name: Etherscan
providers.whyUseful: Great for known onchain entities and verification workflows.
providers.whenToUse: Specific wallets, contracts, tx hashes, token holders, onchain history.
providers.whenNotToUse: General market mapping without specific identifiers.
exampleQueryShapes: Inspect this contract
Verify this transaction

providers.name: The Graph
providers.whyUseful: Structured protocol and network analytics for specific indexed ecosystems.
providers.whenToUse: Known protocol metrics or indexed chain data.
providers.whenNotToUse: Broad discovery if you do not already know the relevant protocol/subgraph.
exampleQueryShapes: Get protocol usage metrics
Query indexed events for this protocol

providers.name: URLScan.io
providers.whyUseful: Can add structured signals about a site or URL when web pages are sketchy or sparse.
providers.whenToUse: Inspecting specific URLs or understanding web infrastructure footprints.
exampleQueryShapes: Inspect this URL
What infrastructure does this site use?

providers.name: Google Safe Browsing
providers.whyUseful: Useful guardrail check before trusting or surfacing questionable domains.
exampleQueryShapes: Is this URL suspicious?

fallbackPolicy.default: Use curated structured APIs only for narrow known-entity lookups. For broad discovery, keep using free web search first.
fallbackPolicy.broadMapping: Do not route broad ecosystem / landscape / roundup prompts directly to structured free APIs unless an entity-specific subtask has already been extracted.
fallbackPolicy.paidEscalationHint: If free structured APIs do not cover the query intent or return sparse results, continue through rewrite + paid escalation logic.
